Remark
Source: topping:page-0046 1. ch3:1.3\group maximum-principle

The scalar strong maximum principle strengthens the conclusion to $u(\cdot ,t)<\phi (t)$ for $t\in (0,T]$, unless $u(x,t)=\phi (t)$ for every $x\in \M $ and $t\in [0,T]$.
